text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Japan Cup. Who will reign 
supreme as the strongest in Japan? The 
crowd's attention was focused entirely on 
that question.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Waiting for the race, Duramente remained 
calm. No trace of her former instability 
lingered. She was nearing completion as 
the "strongest."

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
"...Have I managed to grow, too, I wonder? 
While lost in such thoughts, she said: 
'Entrust it to me'—because those feelings 
become strength."

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
What I entrust to her is... Absolute 
victory. The strongest run. I believe that 
she can show it to us.

text_block_list.name: Trainer's Journal
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand issues a declaration of war 
to Duramente as she heads toward the 
track. At long last, the battle to decide 
who is truly the strongest begins.
